statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in musl's qsort (src/stdlib/qsort.c). third_party/musl-math holds only musl's double-precision maths functions; qsort is not among them. The musl C library that is linked is Alpine's package, which carries the fix.

The flaw is in musl's iconv GB18030 decoder (src/locale/iconv.c). third_party/musl-math holds only musl's double-precision maths functions; iconv is not among them. The musl C library that is linked is Alpine's package, which carries the fix.
